question: How much correction does the unchanged mask prompt with Astra low need when it handles every ASv6.8 subject from ten additional corpus notes?
subject_input_normalization: Existing runner removes long NIP-19 identifiers only; all other text remains. Masks receive the complete original note.
mask_calls: One for every generated subject; subject count frozen after subject generation and before any mask inference.
scope: No subject or mask output rewrites

review.all_outputs: Assistant inspects every generated subject and mask.
criteria: No additional source meanings outside that subject
review.upstream: Unsupported or unmaskable supplied subjects are flagged separately; all remain in the raw data and still receive a mask call.
review.human_sample: Include disputed masks and a small sample the assistant considers correct; no prefilled decisions.
review.counts: Report counts and concrete problems for this batch, not population accuracy or a predeclared pass rate.
